subject: another motivation for MML or VB

messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: another motivation for MML or VB
parts:
Hi all. We had an exchange on stan-users regarding the slowness of models with latent multivariate random variables. This made me think that this could be a good test example for MML and VB methods that can integrate over these latent variables. Worth thinking about as we develop and implement these approximate algorithms.
A

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] another motivation for MML or VB
parts:
Isn’t this going to be exactly the kind of model with high enough curvature
that MML and VB would yield poor approximations? I hate to be the wet
blanket, but the same pathologies that make Euclidean HMC slow also
make these approximations slow, so there’s only only a narrow slice in
model space where MML and VB could flourish.
